description: This file implements X.509 certificate-based authentication for Kubernetes API server, including certificate verification, user extraction, and metrics collection.

classes.name: UserConversion
classes.description: Interface for extracting user info from a client certificate chain.

classes.name: Authenticator
classes.description: Authenticates requests using client certificates and converts them into user info.

classes.name: Verifier
classes.description: Verifies client certificates and delegates authentication.

methods.name: User
methods.description: Implements UserConversion interface, converts a chain into user info.

methods.name: AuthenticateRequest
methods.description: Authenticates an HTTP request based on TLS client certificates.

methods.name: verifySubject
methods.description: Checks if the certificate's subject CN is in the allowed list.

methods.name: parseUIDFromCert
methods.description: Extracts UID from certificate subject if feature enabled.
